channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: From Hope to Anger: Why Nepal’s Gen Z Is Turning Against the Government It Helped Install After Deadly Protests
item.description: Disillusioned by unmet promises on justice, jobs and corruption, Nepal’s Gen Z is protesting again.

item.title: US Embassy Warns Indian Students: Visa Revocation And Deportation For Breaking American Laws During Studies
item.description: The US Embassy warns Indian students that law violations could result in permanent travel bans and deportation.

item.title: Roundglass Foundation Wins Junoon ’25 for Building Climate Resilience Across 2,900 Villages in Punjab
item.description: Roundglass Foundation was recognised at Junoon ’25 for community-driven climate solutions transforming rural Punjab through scale, sustainability, and local ownership.

item.title: Karnataka: Tragic Boiler Explosion At Belagavi Sugar Factory Kills Three Workers And Leaves Five Critically Injured
item.description: A devastating boiler explosion at a Belagavi sugar factory claimed three lives and left several injured.

item.title: Digi Yatra Glitch at Mumbai Airport: Facial Recognition Fails to Distinguish Identical Twins – Here’s What Travellers Should Know
item.description: A rare facial recognition error delayed identical twins at Mumbai airport, raising questions about biometric reliability and human oversight in digital travel systems.

item.title: Admission Row Over Muslim Students: NMC Cancels MBBS Approval at Vaishno Devi College Citing ‘Gross Deficiencies’
item.description: Following complaints surprise inspection the NMC cancelled MBBS approval at a Jammu and Kashmir medical college relocating students.

item.title: Renowned Indian Ecologist Dr Madhav Gadgil, Architect Of Western Ghats Protection, Passes Away at 83 in Pune
item.description: India mourns the passing of pioneering ecologist Madhav Gadgil, who died in Pune aged eighty-three.

item.title: Tariff Shock: US Imposes 500% Tariffs on Countries Buying Russian Oil, Putting India Under the Spotlight
item.description: A sweeping US law targeting buyers of Russian oil aims to weaken Moscow’s war finances but risks triggering energy shocks and new trade tensions worldwide.

item.title: Fatal ICE Shooting in Minneapolis Triggers Protests, Conflicting Official Accounts, and Widespread Demands for Accountability
item.description: A woman’s death during a federal ICE operation has ignited protests, conflicting official accounts, and demands for accountability in Minneapolis.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Health To Connect Personal Medical Records And Wellness Apps For Millions Globally
item.description: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Health, allowing users to sync medical records and wellness apps for personalised health insights.
